shortBio.en: Sonic Youth guitarist; alternate tunings and prepared-guitar noise as composition.
shortBio.zh: Sonic Youth 吉他手；另调弦与预制吉他噪音当作曲。

body.en:
Born 1958. Co-founds Sonic Youth. Daydream Nation dual-guitar with Ranaldo. Noise/shoegaze-adjacent textures without abandoning song forms.

Tuning charts are the method export.
body.zh:
1958 年生。共同创办 Sonic Youth。与 Ranaldo 在 Daydream Nation 双吉他。噪音/与 shoegaze 相邻的纹理，不丢歌曲形式。

调弦表即方法输出。
